mandatory_preflight: Read current REA binary_session with exact package version and available provider/capability groups, using the service environment rather than only the SSH login PATH.

Select only tools whose ACTUAL operation has a compatible provider installed AND usable on the Ubuntu host, with legitimate permission/licensing and required real fixture. A visible name or advertised_available=true is insufficient.

Fail closed for unsupported_host, provider_missing, Hopper-only capability without proven usable license/demo, or IDA/JEB requests without active configured service. Do not test by bypassing license or simulating vendor.
For multi-provider native tools select a verified freely usable Ghidra/Kuna route; NEVER select Hopper/IDA implicitly when free route works. If no free route is confirmed, defer.

Distinguish provider physically installed from functional bridge/session, entitlement/demo state, available device, and selected target support. Avoid macOS-specific utilities on Linux, but do not exclude an OS-neutral IPA/Mach-O parser simply by its file extension.

Require real original MCP positive and negative tests for the exact provider/tool/input family, independent cross-checks where possible, SHA-256 and cleanup verification. Only then grant bounded functional certification.
Respect existing 125 original + 8 supplemental scoped certifications. Do not repeat completed profiles, count tool-catalog entries as certifications, or modify original REA source.

For additional prerequisites such as an authorized browser CDP session, physical USB device, real GPU code fixture, signed PE certificate fixture or licensed engine, defer without generating fake inputs just for a PASS.
No paid supplier purchase, license circumvention, installation/upgrade of optional providers, new engine/MCP/Skill/plugin/server, or changes to other projects as part of this eligibility rule.
Use the provider audit and this file as an operator selection policy; it does not automatically enforce a runtime firewall or change the tool catalog. Revalidate at each new certification turn.

certification_scope_convention.current_user_request: Do not certify tools unavailable for this environment or whose supplier requires a paid/unverified activation. Preserve existing evidence; schedule other tests only when justified by real use.
